metaTitle: Custom Set In Sleeve Sweaters & Cardigans | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set in sleeve sweaters and cardigans for your team. Perfect for uniforms and corporate gifts. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Set in sleeve construction offers a clean, tailored look that sits neatly at the shoulder seam, making these sweaters and cardigans ideal for professional uniforms and corporate apparel. Unlike raglan or drop shoulder styles, the set in sleeve provides a crisp silhouette that layers well under blazers or lab coats. Choose from pique knits or fine gauge wool blends for a polished appearance that holds up to frequent wear and embroidery.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve sweaters and cardigans with embroidered logo, perfect for corporate uniforms
